cohort: The study included nulliparous adolescents aged 13-18 years and parous adults aged 18 years or older who received a levonorgestrel intrauterine system (LNG-IUS).
finding: Nulliparous adolescents who undergo LNG-IUS placement experience statistically higher pain scores and more post-insertional discomfort compared with parous adults during the 2-week study period.
